rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a woman whose husband has died and who has not remarried.

example.english: After her husband died, she became a widow and raised two children on her own.
example.traditional: 佢丈夫過身之後成為寡婦，獨力湊大兩個仔女。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoeng6 fu1 gwo3 san1 zi1 hau6 sing4 wai4 gwaa2 fu5 duk6 lik6 cau3 daai6 loeng5 go3 zai2 neoi2

rows.note: A speaker uses this colloquial term especially for a widowed mother, often with an old-fashioned or slightly derogatory tone.

example.english: That widow raised several children alone; it was really not easy.
example.traditional: 嗰個寡母婆一個人湊大幾個仔女，真係唔容易。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 gwaa2 mou5 po2 jat1 go3 jan4 cau3 daai6 gei2 go3 zai2 neoi2 zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 ji6
